ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
该道谢的是我才对……谢谢你的汽水……
那我不客气啦……！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 辛、辛苦了……！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 啊……谢、谢谢你……！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_005
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 这些叫粗点心，是平民吃的零食！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 那么矢仓蓬咲，要上了——！！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我们该不会，被拉黑了吧……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_008
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我、我完全听不懂你在说什么！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 矢仓蓬咲，奇迹般地完成任务啦～～～！！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_010
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 挖、挖掘《鬼时雨》感想也包含在内！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 对，就是这样的！！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_012
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 呀——靠太近了！！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_013
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我……要哈密瓜味的！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
距、距离那次才过去不到一个月啊……！
演出本来是要办这么多次的吗……！？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_015
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
是的……在规定时间内啪嗒啪嗒地敲键盘录入数据……
结果敲得肩膀都僵硬了……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_016
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
一、不会因为Family
让任何人放弃自己珍视的东西，是这个吧？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_017
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 《鬼时雨》可是我的圣经！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_018
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 呜～手指又破皮了……连指尖都这么软弱……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_019
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 噫！啊，什么啊……原来是我自己的影子啊

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_020
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 阿嚏！呜～我连花粉都斗不过……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_021
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我吃不惯艾草味的东西……明明我名字里的『蓬』字就是艾草

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_022
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我不喜欢夏天……太阳的存在感太强了……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_023
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 海、海边绝对不行！不全都是可怕的人吗！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_024
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 在读书之秋，来一本《鬼时雨》如何！？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_025
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 什锦饭里的蘑菇……得全都挑出来才行

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_026
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 冬天的夜晚真不错呢，安静又让人放松～

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_027
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 呜～又摔倒了……！城市里的雪，太容易让人滑倒了……！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_000
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
该道谢的是我才对……谢谢你的汽水……
那我不客气啦……！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_001
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 辛、辛苦了……！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_002
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 啊……谢、谢谢你……！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_005
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 这些叫粗点心，是平民吃的零食！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_006
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 那么矢仓蓬咲，要上了——！！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_007
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 我们该不会，被拉黑了吧……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_008
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 我、我完全听不懂你在说什么！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_009
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 矢仓蓬咲，奇迹般地完成任务啦～～～！！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_010
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 挖、挖掘《鬼时雨》感想也包含在内！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_011
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 对，就是这样的！！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_012
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 呀——靠太近了！！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_013
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 我……要哈密瓜味的！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_014
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
距、距离那次才过去不到一个月啊……！
演出本来是要办这么多次的吗……！？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_015
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
是的……在规定时间内啪嗒啪嗒地敲键盘录入数据……
结果敲得肩膀都僵硬了……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_016
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
一、不会因为Family
让任何人放弃自己珍视的东西，是这个吧？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_017
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 《鬼时雨》可是我的圣经！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_018
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 呜～手指又破皮了……连指尖都这么软弱……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_019
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 噫！啊，什么啊……原来是我自己的影子啊

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_020
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 阿嚏！呜～我连花粉都斗不过……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_021
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 我吃不惯艾草味的东西……明明我名字里的『蓬』字就是艾草

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_022
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 我不喜欢夏天……太阳的存在感太强了……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_023
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 海、海边绝对不行！不全都是可怕的人吗！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_024
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 在读书之秋，来一本《鬼时雨》如何！？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_025
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 什锦饭里的蘑菇……得全都挑出来才行

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_026
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 冬天的夜晚真不错呢，安静又让人放松～

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_027
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 呜～又摔倒了……！城市里的雪，太容易让人滑倒了……！
